description: Defines data structures CaptureArgs and DisplayCaptureArgs for capturing display content, including parameters like pixel format, crop rectangle, scale, and protection options, within the android::gui namespace.

classes.name: CaptureArgs
classes.description: Holds parameters for capturing display content, including pixel format, crop, scale, protection, and dataspace options.

classes.name: DisplayCaptureArgs
classes.description: Extends CaptureArgs with display-specific parameters such as display token, width, height, and transform usage.
